# Recipe model with toolchains: Node-only default, settings API, live preview route, migration

## What to build

graph-manager (`apps/graph-manager`) builds the default sandbox image from a **recipe** kept in `graph-manager.json` (`sandboxRecipe`). Today the recipe is `{ base, packages, extraLines }`, and the default installs Python, Java, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP and C/C++ up front. This slice changes the recipe model to **opt-in toolchains**:

- A recipe becomes `{ base, toolchains, extraLines }`. `toolchains` always lists all 7 built-in toolchains (`python`, `java`, `go`, `rust`, `ruby`, `php`, `cpp`), each as `{ id, enabled, snippet }`. The array order is the Dockerfile order.
- The default recipe is **Node only**: base `node:24.22.1-bookworm`, every toolchain `enabled: false` with its default snippet, and `extraLines: ""`. Its Dockerfile is exactly `FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm\n`.
- A new route, `POST /api/sandbox/dockerfile`, previews a recipe that isn't saved.
- A recipe stored in the old shape is migrated when it is read.
- Snippets and extra lines are kept verbatim, not trimmed line by line, so indentation inside a `RUN <<EOF` heredoc survives.

This slice is server only. Other slices change the web UI (`src/web`) and per-workspace recipes. Don't touch `src/web` here, apart from keeping `npm run typecheck` green: if `src/web/types.ts` breaks nothing, leave it alone. Leave `workspaceSettings` alone too, except where a type forces a change.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-image.ts`, all 238 lines:
  - lines 104–205: `IMAGE_PATTERN`, `SandboxRecipe`, `DEFAULT_RECIPE`, `recipeSchema`, `defaultRecipe`, `normalizePackages`, `normalizeRecipe`, `sandboxDockerfile`, `sandboxImageTag` and `validateRecipe`, which you replace or rewrite.
  - Keep `cliDockerfile`, `ensureCliImage`, `ensureClisVolume`, `ensureSandboxImage` and `removeOldImages` (lines 1–103 and 206–238) unchanged.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-image.test.ts`, lines 150–195: the `sandboxDockerfile` and `validateRecipe` tests to rewrite. Lines 196–325 are `Sandboxes image build` tests; they use `DEFAULT_RECIPE` and recipes with `packages`, so update them to the new shape.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`, lines 60–70: `sandboxRecipe: recipeSchema.optional()`. Add the migration here.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.ts`, lines 1–70: `settingsView`, `GET/PUT /api/settings/sandbox`, `POST /api/sandbox/rebuild`, `GET /api/sandbox/build`. You add `POST /api/sandbox/dockerfile` here.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.test.ts`, lines 62–163: the settings route tests, which use `packages`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox.ts`:
  - lines 286–295: `recipe()` and `defaultImage()`. They use `defaultRecipe` and `sandboxDockerfile`; no change should be needed.
  - line 39: `DEFAULT_SANDBOX_IMAGE = DEFAULT_RECIPE.base`.
- `apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-docker.mjs`, lines 589–610: the fake `POST /build` records `{ tag, nocache, labels, dockerfile }`, and a Dockerfile containing `FAKE_BUILD_FAIL` fails.
- `grep -rn "packages" apps/graph-manager/src/server --include=*.ts` lists every use of the old field to update: tests, `sandbox.docker.test.ts` and `sandbox.e2e.test.ts`.

## Patterns to follow

**The new model** (in `sandbox-image.ts`, replacing lines 106–205):

```ts
export type ToolchainId = "python" | "java" | "go" | "rust" | "ruby" | "php" | "cpp";
export const TOOLCHAIN_IDS: ToolchainId[] = ["python", "java", "go", "rust", "ruby", "php", "cpp"];
const apt = (pkgs: string) => `RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ${pkgs} && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*`;
/** The built-in toolchains, in the default order, with their default snippets. */
export const TOOLCHAINS: { id: ToolchainId; name: string; snippet: string }[] = [
  { id: "python", name: "Python", snippet: apt("python3 python3-pip python3-venv pipx") },
  { id: "java", name: "Java", snippet: apt("default-jdk-headless maven gradle") },
  { id: "go", name: "Go", snippet: "COPY --from=golang:1-bookworm /usr/local/go /usr/local/go\nENV PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH" },
  { id: "rust", name: "Rust", snippet: [
      "COPY --from=rust:1-bookworm /usr/local/cargo /usr/local/cargo",
      "COPY --from=rust:1-bookworm /usr/local/rustup /usr/local/rustup",
      "ENV RUSTUP_HOME=/usr/local/rustup CARGO_HOME=/usr/local/cargo PATH=/usr/local/cargo/bin:$PATH",
      "RUN chmod -R a+rwX /usr/local/cargo /usr/local/rustup",
    ].join("\n") },
  { id: "ruby", name: "Ruby", snippet: apt("ruby-full") },
  { id: "php", name: "PHP", snippet: apt("php-cli composer") },
  { id: "cpp", name: "C/C++", snippet: apt("build-essential pkg-config cmake") },
];
export interface RecipeToolchain { id: ToolchainId; enabled: boolean; snippet: string }
export interface SandboxRecipe { base: string; toolchains: RecipeToolchain[]; extraLines: string }
export const DEFAULT_RECIPE: SandboxRecipe = {
  base: "node:24.22.1-bookworm",
  toolchains: TOOLCHAINS.map((t) => ({ id: t.id, enabled: false, snippet: t.snippet })),
  extraLines: "",
};
```

- `defaultRecipe(config)` returns a **deep copy** of `DEFAULT_RECIPE` (new `toolchains` array, new objects), with `base: config.sandboxImage` when that is set.

**Schema** (zod, `.strict()`, as the current `recipeSchema` at line 149):

```ts
const toolchainSchema = z.object({ id: z.enum(["python","java","go","rust","ruby","php","cpp"]), enabled: z.boolean(), snippet: z.string().max(20000) }).strict();
export const recipeSchema = z.object({ base: z.string().trim().max(255), toolchains: z.array(toolchainSchema).max(7), extraLines: z.string().max(20000) }).strict();
```

**Migration**:
- `migrateRecipe(raw: unknown): unknown`. When `raw` is an object with a `packages` array and no `toolchains`, return `{ base, toolchains: DEFAULT_RECIPE's toolchains (all disabled), extraLines }`.
- The `extraLines` is `apt(<packages, trimmed, deduplicated and sorted, joined by spaces>)` + `"\n"` + the old extraLines. With no packages, it's just the old extraLines.
- Anything else is returned unchanged.
- In `store.ts`, use `sandboxRecipe: z.preprocess(migrateRecipe, recipeSchema).optional()`. `recipeSchema` is already imported from `./sandbox-image.js`. Export `migrateRecipe` so task 3 can reuse it for workspace recipes.

**Dockerfile**:

```ts
const clean = (s: string) => s.replace(/\r/g, "").replace(/\n+$/, "");
export function sandboxDockerfile(r: SandboxRecipe): string {
  const parts = [`FROM ${r.base.trim()}`];
  for (const t of r.toolchains) {
    if (!t.enabled) continue;
    const name = TOOLCHAINS.find((x) => x.id === t.id)?.name ?? t.id;
    parts.push(`# ${name}`);
    const s = clean(t.snippet);
    if (s.trim() !== "") parts.push(s);
  }
  const extra = clean(r.extraLines);
  if (extra.trim() !== "") parts.push(extra);
  return `${parts.join("\n")}\n`;
}
```

- Lines are kept verbatim; only `\r` and trailing newlines are dropped. Blank lines inside a snippet stay.

**Validation** (replace lines 194–205). Return the first problem:
1. `base: not a valid image reference` when `!IMAGE_PATTERN.test(r.base.trim())`.
2. `toolchains: must list each of python, java, go, rust, ruby, php, cpp exactly once` unless the ids are a permutation of `TOOLCHAIN_IDS`.
3. For each toolchain in order, `toolchains.<id>: FROM is not allowed; use COPY --from=<image>` when any line's first word is `FROM`, case-insensitively. Use the existing check: `/^from$/i.test(line.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] ?? "")`.
4. `extraLines: FROM is not allowed; use COPY --from=<image>`, the same check.
5. `extraLines: at most 20000 characters`, and `toolchains.<id>: at most 20000 characters`.

**Normalization**:
- `normalizeRecipe(r)` returns `{ base: r.base.trim(), toolchains: r.toolchains.map(t => ({ id: t.id, enabled: t.enabled, snippet: t.snippet.replace(/\r/g, "") })), extraLines: r.extraLines.replace(/\r/g, "") }`.
- Remove `normalizePackages` and `PACKAGE_PATTERN`.

**Error handling in routes**: mirror `routes/sandbox.ts` lines 34–43. `validateRecipe` returns a message, and the route answers `reply.code(400).send({ error })`. zod parse errors are turned into 400s by the app's error handler, as today.

**Test pattern**: `sandbox-image.test.ts` uses pure function tests, plus `startFakeDocker` and `Sandboxes` for builds. `routes/sandbox.test.ts` uses `appWithLogin({ dockerSocket: fake.socketPath })` and `ctx.app.inject({ method, url, headers: { cookie: ctx.cookie }, payload })`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-image.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `ToolchainId`, `TOOLCHAIN_IDS`, `TOOLCHAINS`, `RecipeToolchain`, `SandboxRecipe`, `DEFAULT_RECIPE`, `recipeSchema`, `defaultRecipe`, `migrateRecipe`, `normalizeRecipe`, `sandboxDockerfile` and `validateRecipe`, as above.
  - Update the file's top comment to describe the toolchains.
- **GOTCHA**:
  - Keep `sandboxImageTag`, `IMAGE_PATTERN`, `ensureSandboxImage` and `removeOldImages` exported with the same signatures; `sandbox.ts` and `routes/sandbox.ts` import them.
  - `DEFAULT_RECIPE` must never be mutated. Always copy it.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck -w graph-manager`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `sandboxRecipe: z.preprocess(migrateRecipe, recipeSchema).optional()`, and update its doc comment.
- **GOTCHA**: `z.preprocess(...).optional()` changes the inferred type. Check that `Data["sandboxRecipe"]` is still `SandboxRecipe | undefined`.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `settingsView()` returns `{ limits, recipe, defaultRecipe, toolchains: TOOLCHAINS, dockerfile, image: sandboxImageTag(dockerfile) }`.
  - `PUT /api/settings/sandbox` stays as it is: validate, normalize, and queue a build via `ctx.sandboxes.ensureImages()` when the Dockerfile changed, with 409 while building.
  - Add `POST /api/sandbox/dockerfile`. The body is `z.object({ recipe: recipeSchema }).strict()`. Answer `200 { dockerfile: sandboxDockerfile(normalizeRecipe(recipe)), image: sandboxImageTag(...), error?: validateRecipe(recipe) }`. Leave `error` out when the recipe is valid. Save nothing.
- **GOTCHA**: a body that doesn't match the zod schema (unknown key, wrong type) is still a 400. Only `validateRecipe` problems answer 200 with `error`.

### UPDATE the tests

**`sandbox-image.test.ts`**:
- `DEFAULT_RECIPE` gives `"FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm\n"`.
- Enabling python gives `"FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm\n# Python\nRUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 python3-pip python3-venv pipx && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*\n"`.
- With rust moved before python and both enabled, `# Rust` comes before `# Python`.
- A disabled toolchain with an edited snippet adds nothing.
- **Regression test for F7**: extra lines `"RUN <<EOF\n  set -e\n    echo hi\nEOF"` appear verbatim, indentation kept.
- `validateRecipe` returns each message above, including `toolchains.python: FROM is not allowed; use COPY --from=<image>` for a snippet `"RUN true\n  from ubuntu"`, the toolchains-permutation message for a missing id and for a duplicate id, and `undefined` for `DEFAULT_RECIPE`.
- `migrateRecipe({ base: "node:22", packages: ["jq", "curl", "jq"], extraLines: "RUN true" })` gives `{ base: "node:22", toolchains: <all disabled defaults>, extraLines: apt("curl jq") + "\nRUN true" }`.
- `defaultRecipe({ sandboxImage: "debian:12" }).base` is `"debian:12"`, and mutating the result doesn't change `DEFAULT_RECIPE`.
- Update the `Sandboxes image build` tests that build `{ ...DEFAULT_RECIPE, packages: … }`. For example, a "new recipe" is now `{ ...defaultRecipe({}), extraLines: "RUN true" }`.
- Assertions on the default Dockerfile's content (python3, `/usr/local/go`) now check `FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm` only.

**`routes/sandbox.test.ts`**:
- `GET` answers `recipe` and `defaultRecipe` equal to `DEFAULT_RECIPE`, `toolchains` equal to `TOOLCHAINS`, `dockerfile` `"FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm\n"` and `image` matching `/^gm-sandbox:[0-9a-f]{12}$/`.
- `PUT` with python enabled stores it and calls `ensureImages`.
- `PUT` with a `FROM` line in a snippet answers 400 `{ error: "toolchains.python: FROM is not allowed; use COPY --from=<image>" }`.
- `POST /api/sandbox/dockerfile` answers 200 with the Dockerfile for a valid recipe, and 200 with `error` for a `FROM` snippet, with nothing stored.
- It answers 400 for `{ recipe: { ...r, extra: 1 } }` and 401 without login.
- Store migration: write an old-shape `sandboxRecipe` into `graph-manager.json` before `DataStore.open`. Look at how `store.test.ts` writes a file first. Check that `store.get().sandboxRecipe.extraLines` starts with `RUN apt-get update`.

**Other tests**: in `sandbox.docker.test.ts`, `sandbox.e2e.test.ts` and anything else `grep -rn "packages" apps/graph-manager/src/server` finds, move to the new shape.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/settings/sandbox` with nothing saved answers `{ limits, recipe, defaultRecipe, toolchains, dockerfile: "FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm\n", image: "gm-sandbox:<12 hex>" }`, with all 7 toolchains `enabled: false`.
- [ ] `PUT /api/settings/sandbox` with `{ recipe }` (python enabled) saves it and starts a build whose Dockerfile, as seen by the fake Docker, has `# Python` and the python apt line.
- [ ] Toolchain order in the recipe is the order in the Dockerfile.
- [ ] A `FROM` line in a snippet or the extra lines answers 400 with `toolchains.<id>: …` or `extraLines: …`.
- [ ] `POST /api/sandbox/dockerfile` answers 200 `{ dockerfile, image }`, or 200 `{ dockerfile, image, error }` for an invalid recipe, and never saves.
- [ ] Heredoc indentation in the extra lines is kept verbatim.
- [ ] An old `{ base, packages, extraLines }` recipe in `graph-manager.json` loads as the new shape with an apt line first in the extra lines.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/sandbox-image.test.ts src/server/routes/sandbox.test.ts src/server/store.test.ts
npm test -w graph-manager
```
